name: MACS J0159.0-3412 (Hubble)
blurb: MACS J0159.0-3412, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: macsj015903412-hubble
story: A swarm of galaxies bound in one of the most X-ray-luminous clusters known. Its X-ray glow shows several peaks and no clear central galaxy, marking it as one of the most disturbed clusters in its class.

claims.text: MACS J0159.0-3412 is a cluster in a statistically complete sample of 108 of the most X-ray-luminous clusters from the MAssive Cluster Survey, at z = 0.41
Its morphological code 4 means poor X-ray-optical alignment, multiple peaks and an ambiguous brightest cluster galaxy, the most disturbed class
MACSJ0159.0-3412 is a target of HST program 15843, a snapshot survey of the most massive galaxy clusters
